text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Training quota achieved.
I feel like I could still do a bit more, but—
What in the world is going on here—?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That figure sprinting at full power against the setting sun! And that spirit, resolutely declaring, 'I can still keep going!'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pure grit that puts even princesses to shame!!
Such passion makes my heart—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No! It tore right through my chest, and even my back was burning with passion~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I am truly humbled.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who should thank Ikuno-san! To fire me up this much!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like... I could fly all the way to the upper atmosphere to greet my Prince!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Entering the atmosphere bare-bodied is extremely hazardous. I shall accompany you as well.
choice_data_list: Let's keep watch to make sure nothing dangerous happens.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Entering the atmosphere bare-bodied is extremely hazardous. I shall accompany you as well.
choice_data_list: Let's keep watch to make sure nothing dangerous happens.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh... hah... I, see...
This is... good bodyweight training...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fired up, the two elevated each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...
Watching over them to act as a stopper is also important."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it a day here, Kawakami-san.
I'm sure it's about time for the prince to head to bed, too.
